# nagios_service (Resource)

Manages a Nagios XI service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nagios_service" "example" {
  service_name           = "web01-http"
  host_name               = [nagios_host.example.host_name]
  description              = "HTTP"
  check_command             = "check_http"
  max_check_attempts        = "3"
  check_interval             = "5"
  retry_interval              = "1"
  check_period                 = "24x7"
  notification_interval        = "30"
  notification_period           = "24x7"
  contacts                      = ["nagiosadmin"]
  templates                      = ["generic-service"]

  free_variables = {
    "_environment" = "production"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_command` (String) The name of the command that should be used to check the status of the service
- `check_interval` (String) The number of minutes to wait until the next regular check of the service
- `check_period` (String) The time period during which active checks of the service can be made
- `contacts` (Set of String) The list of users that Nagios should alert when a service is down
- `description` (String) Defines the description of the service. It may contain spaces, dashes and colons (avoid using semicolons, apostrophes and quotation marks)
- `host_name` (Set of String) The hosts that the service should run on
- `max_check_attempts` (String) How many times to retry the service check before alerting when the state is anything other than OK
- `notification_interval` (String) How long to wait before sending another notification to a contact that the service is down
- `notification_period` (String) The time period during which notifications can be sent for a service alert
- `retry_interval` (String) The number of minutes to wait until re-checking the service
- `service_name` (String) The name of the service

### Optional

- `action_url` (String) URL to a third-party documentation repository containing actions to take in the event the service goes down
- `active_checks_enabled` (Boolean) Sets whether or not active checks are enabled for the service
- `check_freshness` (Boolean) Sets whether or not freshness checks are enabled for the service
- `contact_groups` (Set of String) A list of the contact groups that should be notified if the service goes down
- `display_name` (String) Another name for the service that will be displayed in the web interface
- `event_handler` (String) The command that should be run whenever a change in the state of the service is detected
- `event_handler_enabled` (Boolean) Sets whether or not event handlers should be enabled for the service
- `first_notification_delay` (String) The amount of time to wait to send out the first notification when a service enters a non-UP state
- `flap_detection_enabled` (Boolean) Sets whether or not flap detection is enabled for the service
- `flap_detection_options` (Set of String) Determines what flap detection logic will be used for the service. One or more of the following valid options can be provided: 'd' down, 'o' up, or 'u' unreachable
- `free_variables` (Map of String) A key/value pair of free variables to add to the service. The key must begin with an underscore.
- `freshness_threshold` (String) The freshness threshold used for the service
- `high_flap_threshold` (String) The maximum threshold that should be used when detecting if flapping is occurring
- `icon_image` (String) The icon to display in Nagios
- `icon_image_alt` (String) The text to display when hovering over the icon_image or the text to display if the icon_image is unavailable
- `initial_state` (String) By default, Nagios will assume the service is in an OK state. Valid options are: 'd' down, 's' up or 'u' unreachable
- `is_volatile` (Boolean) Determines if the service is 'volatile'. Services typically are not volatile and this should be disabled.
- `low_flap_threshold` (String) The minimum threshold that should be used when detecting if flapping is occurring
- `notes` (String) Notes about the service that may assist with troubleshooting
- `notes_url` (String) URL to a third-party documentation repository containing more information about the service
- `notification_options` (Set of String) Determines when Nagios should alert if a service is one or more of the following options: 'o' up, 'd' down, 'u' unreachable, 'r' recovery, 'f' flapping or 's' scheduled downtime
- `notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Determines if Nagios should send notifications
- `obsess_over_service` (Boolean) Sets whether or not Nagios 'obsesses' over the service using the ocsp_command
- `passive_checks_enabled` (Boolean) Sets whether or not passive checks are enabled for the service
- `process_perf_data` (Boolean) Determines if Nagios should process performance data
- `register` (Boolean) Determines if the service will be marked as active or inactive
- `retain_nonstatus_information` (Boolean) Sets whether or not non-status related information should be kept for the service
- `retain_status_information` (Boolean) Sets whether or not status related information should be kept for the service
- `templates` (Set of String) A list of service templates to apply to the service

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Services can be imported by their service_name.
terraform import nagios_service.example web01-http
```
